g.title: Your business information is scattered, this makes it difficult to see what's actually happening.
TRACK brings the important information across your business into one connected view, so you can see what's happening, understand what needs your attention, and make better decisions.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
When your business information is everywhere, getting the full picture takes work.

Sales numbers are in one app. Customer information is in WhatsApp or a CRM. Expenses are in a spreadsheet. Your team holds important information in reports and conversations. You see your business clearly only when you bring everything together.
Money moves across accounts, but it can be difficult to see the full picture.
Customer information exists in different places, making changes in buying behaviour easy to miss.
Operational information can be spread across people, processes and tools.
Important decisions can rely on memory, scattered reports or information gathered manually.
You already have information. The challenge is seeing what it means.
TRACK is built around a simple idea: business owners should not have to piece together information from different places just to understand how their business is doing.
TRACK connects the important parts of your business into one clear view.
Instead of checking different tools and reports separately, TRACK brings relevant business information together so you can understand what is happening and where attention may be needed.
See what comes in, what goes out, and what is left.
Understand who buys, how often they buy, and when customer behaviour changes.
Keep sight of the processes and activities that keep your business moving.
Know who owns what and spot gaps or bottlenecks early.
See signals that can help you understand where the business is growing and where it needs attention.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
A clearer view of your business, without piecing it together yourself.
TRACK turns important business information into a view that is easier to understand. See changes, patterns and signals across the parts of your business that matter.
Numbers are useful. Knowing what needs your attention is even more useful.
TRACK is designed to help you move beyond collecting information. It helps surface changes, risks and opportunities so you can focus on what matters.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
From business information to clearer decisions.
Capture the important information you already use to run the business.
TRACK organizes relevant information into a clearer view.
See patterns, changes and signals across your business.
Focus on the areas that may require action.
Use the information to make more informed business decisions.
Your business doesn't need more information. It needs a clearer view of the information you already have.
TRACK is not designed to replace every tool you already use. It is designed to help connect the important signals across your business so you can understand the bigger picture.
Good for storing and working with information.
Good for managing your financial records.
Your sales performance is 30% better compare to last month
Your sales performance is 15% better compare to last month
Good for managing specific parts of the business.
Built for business owners who are growing and need a clearer view of what is happening.
Whether your business information lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp, POS systems, accounting tools, customer records or team reports, TRACK is designed to help you bring the important pieces together.
Stop piecing your business together. Start seeing the full picture.
TRACK helps you understand what is happening in your business, what has changed, and what may need your attention.
Your business is in good shape, but expenses need attention.
Join the waitlist and be among the first to experience TRACK.
See what is happening. Know what needs your attention.
© 2026 TRACK. Built for African business owners.
